snippet.title: BLOOD MALL: PART II - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
BLOOD MALL: PART II is a retro-style dinosaur horror game that picks up exactly where BLOOD MALL left off. As a fully fledged game, BLOOD MALL: PART II takes the player through five distinct chapters set in fresh locations, armed with badass new weapons, multiple unique and ferocious enemies, and an elevated story with a cast of groovy characters.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4177120/BLOOD_MALL_PART_II/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
